The PKGBUILD downloads a SHA-256 pinned .deb archive from the official upstream GitHub releases, extracts it, patches internal paths, and installs it. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an 'inconclusive' verdict solely because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error when attempting to audit the .SRCINFO metadata file. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe. The openrouter model (advisory) also found it safe.
coverage_issues: The qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400), which incorrectly forced its overall package verdict to 'inconclusive' despite successfully auditing the executable files.
learnings: Implement graceful degradation for transient LLM API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO). A failure to audit a static metadata file should not override successful audits of executable files (PKGBUILD, shell scripts) to force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict.
